Author: Alok Kumar Verma

 In The High Court Of Uttarakhand
 At Nainital
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Alok Kumar Verma
 04Th September, 2025

1.Swami Ramdev
2.Gulshan Rai Narang ..... Applicants
 Versus

High Court Of Uttarakhand
 At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for the Applicants : Mr. Shashi Kant Shandilya,
 Advocate.
(through video conferencing)

Counsel for the Respondent : Mr. Deepak Bhardwaj, Brief
 Holder.

Counsel for the Informant : Mr. Saurabh Kumar Pandey,
 Advocate.
Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma,J.

This Application for anticipatory bail has been filed by the applicants in Case Crime No.245 of 2025,
registered at Kotwali Haridwar, District Haridwar under Section 420 and Section 120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.

According to the First Information Report dated 27.04.2025, Swami Shivram Das Trust,
Shivdham, Haridwar was registered under the provisions of the Societies Registration Act, 1860.
The renewal of the said Society was only till 16.09.2010.
On the basis of forged documents, the applicants and co-accused got renewal of the Society done on 10.07.2024.

3. Heard Mr. Shashi Kant Shandilya, learned counsel for the applicants, Mr. Deepak Bhardwaj,
learned Brief Holder for the respondent and Mr. Saurabh Kumar Pandey, learned counsel appearing for the informant.
4.
Mr. Shashi Kant Shandilya, Advocate submitted that the applicants are trustees of the said Society.
The informant claims himself to be a disciple of Swami Hans Prakash on the basis of a false and frivolous unregistered will dated 17.12.2012.

There are several civil litigations as well as criminal Swami Ramdev vs State Of Uttarakhand on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/104229035/
1 cases against the trustees, which were filed by the informant or at his behest.

entities.text: criminal Swami Ramdev vs State Of Uttarakhand on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The trustees were going for renewal then one Vipul Kumar had lodged an FIR (FIR No.658 of 2020).

The proceedings of the trial court have been stayed by this Court in the Application (No.1644 of 2022), filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
5.
Mr. Deepak Bhardwaj, Brief Holder has sought three weeks' time to file objection to the anticipatory bail application.
6. Mr. Saurabh Kumar Pandey, learned counsel appearing for the informant, has sought three weeks' time to file his vakalatnama and objection to the anticipatory bail application.
7. Time is granted.

8. Having heard the learned counsel for the parties and in the facts and circumstances of the case, as an ad- interim measure, it is directed that in the event of arrest of the applicants, Swami Ramdev and Gulshan Rai Narang, they shall be released on interim bail on executing a personal bond of Rs.30,000/- and two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, by each one of them, to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Officer, subject to the following conditions:-
(i) Applicants shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency and they shall make themselves available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;
(ii) Applicants shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of this case.
(iii) Applicants shall not leave the country without the previous permission of this Court.
9. List on 16.10.2025 for hearing on the anticipatory bail application.
___________________ ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.
